accepted_product_decision.summary: normal UI has one canonical reconstructed real timeline; raw meter/logger wall clock is secondary evidence
accepted_product_decision.archive_primary_time: single newest fully verified Live/default anchor per physical meter + monotonic ON_TIME -> canonical UTC -> persisted per-meter IANA projection
accepted_product_decision.on_time_role: defines native timeline geometry; active anchor defines only absolute UTC placement
accepted_product_decision.unsafe_reconstruction: fail closed; never silently promote raw meter clock

single_active_anchor.selection: newest fully verified Live/default anchor for the physical meter, ordered primarily by ON_TIME
single_active_anchor.refresh: accepted normal Live/default reads and verified final Default/Live after each History family replace active anchor when ON_TIME advances
single_active_anchor.projection: all Hour/Day/Month/Year boundaries for one meter project backwards from the same active anchor
single_active_anchor.duration_invariant: native adjacent Hour 3600s remains exactly 3600s real time; analogous native Day/Month/Year duration preservation
single_active_anchor.future_archive: archive ON_TIME greater than active anchor fails closed
single_active_anchor.backwards_anchor: backwards/reset ON_TIME cannot silently replace active anchor

history_all_live_delta.status: code-fixed and CI-green; physical spot-check pending
history_all_live_delta.rule: visible Live in mixed History-All uses chronologically nearest trustworthy earlier cumulative observation on same physical meter
history_all_live_delta.priority: chronology only; no archive-family priority and no archive-over-Live preference
history_all_live_delta.consecutive_live: if live1 is later than the newest archive and earlier than live2, live2 uses live1
history_all_live_delta.safety: never cross meter identity, known conflict or unsafe chronology; nearest backwards cumulative total fails closed instead of silently choosing an older source

source_record_id.status: implemented and CI-green; HA transport/export itself not implemented
source_record_id.canonical_input: length-prefixed physical meter identity + archive family + preserved raw logger timestamp + preserved native occurrence key
source_record_id.occurrence_key: normally OT:<on_time_seconds>; deterministic fallback for legacy/native evidence
source_record_id.new_phone: rereading the same physical archive occurrence regenerates the same source_record_id without a backup

home_assistant_transport_contract.phone_sent_ledger: none authoritative; Android may send every eligible locally available record on every transfer
home_assistant_transport_contract.known_id_improved_derived_metadata: update existing record, never create duplicate

statistics_chart_axis_policy.status: implemented centrally, CI-green and physically spot-checked as good
statistics_chart_axis_policy.bars: consumption/flow: complete set horizontal when it fits -> complete set rotated when that fits -> complete set hidden if rotated text would collide
statistics_chart_axis_policy.lines: temperature/battery: measured-fit thinning -> hide labels if remaining set still collides
statistics_chart_axis_policy.data_preservation: axis presentation never drops/merges/aggregates data points or buckets

roadmap_v3_home_assistant.status: planned major future version; no implementation in v2.x
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.architecture: Qalcosonic W1 -> NFC -> Android app -> local connector protocol -> Home Assistant custom integration -> sensors/long-term statistics
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.pairing: HA creates short-lived one-time pairing session and QR code; app scans and redeems over reachable local network
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.qr_security: no Wi-Fi credentials; no normal HA administrator/long-lived user token; issue dedicated least-privilege device/app credential after pairing
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.network_requirement: phone must be able to reach HA connector over same LAN or routable local network; discovery is optional convenience
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.dedupe: Android may resend all eligible local records; HA deduplicates/UPSERTs by deterministic source_record_id
roadmap_v3_home_assistant.android_permission_boundary: v3.0 intentionally introduces network access/INTERNET permission; v2.x remains local NFC only
